params.caption: 🕹️ PS5 passes 100 million consoles shipped Sony has confirmed that PlayStation 5 shipments have reached 100 million units, roughly six years after launch. The milestone puts PS5 in the same club as PS4 and PS2, though it got there a little slower than both, despite supply shortages and price hikes along the way. 🕒 Nov 11, 2026 · 12:45 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: IGN #PS5 #PlayStation #GamingNews
